import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

M = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    names = z.namelist()

    shared = []
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in names:
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        for si in root.findall(M + "si"):
            shared.append("".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter(M + "t")))

    wb_root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    sheets = [(s.get("name"), s.get("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id"))
              for s in wb_root.find(M + "sheets")]
    rels_root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
    rel_map = {r.get("Id"): r.get("Target") for r in rels_root}

    for sheet_name, rid in sheets:
        target = rel_map[rid].lstrip("/")
        if not target.startswith("xl/"):
            target = "xl/" + target
        print(f"\n=== Sheet: {sheet_name} ({target}) ===")
        sroot = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        for row in sroot.iter(M + "row"):
            for c in row.findall(M + "c"):
                ref = c.get("r")
                t = c.get("t")
                v = c.find(M + "v")
                if v is None:
                    continue
                val = v.text
                if t == "s":
                    val = shared[int(val)]
                elif t == "b":
                    val = val == "1"
                print(f"{ref}: {val!r}")
